_about: Known failures per check for tools/run_checks.py (check ids are defined in its CHECKS table).
Each 'known' entry matches failure labels by exact 'label', 'prefix' or 'regex', or 'any': true
(any label; used for checks whose records give only a count). 'count' = how many labels the entry
may absorb (default 1); more are NEW. 'flaky': true = not reported as FIXED when it does not fail.
'broken' = the check cannot complete; the runner skips it unless --include-broken.
Update this file only with a dated reason, after the failure is understood or recorded in
docs/guides/FINAL_VERIFICATION.md. Remove an entry when the runner reports it FIXED.
